caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall shelf featuring an intricate, symmetrical design. The structure is primarily rendered in shades of brown, simulating the appearance of carved wood. At the top center, there is a triangular motif, beneath which are two stylized birds facing each other with prominent wings, situated symmetrically on either side of a central axis. The birds' bodies, wings, and eyes are outlined. The surrounding contours of the shelf’s back plate are jagged and geometric, creating a decorative border. The shelf surface extends horizontally from the central section, supported underneath by a single, centered vertical brace with angular cut-outs and shapes that echo the style of the top border. The design overall is ornamental, with all parts colored in tonal variations of brown, and the background is left plain. The signature “MATIL G. CHAPELIN – TAOS.” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Hanging Wall Shelf
